summary: INV-06 Change member roles: implemented PATCH /api/v1/projects/:projectId/members/:userId enabling Workspace Owner to modify any member role and Project Managers to modify member/viewer roles only. Enforces peer protection (PMs cannot promote/demote peer managers or workspace owner), self-protection (PMs cannot modify own role), sibling privacy (404 NOT_FOUND for outsiders), and optimistic concurrency control (OCC) rejecting stale expectedVersion updates with 409 STALE_VERSION. All automated integration tests pass against local PostgreSQL.
limitations: Assignee reassignment on role change to viewer is handled in CRD-03.
